async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Fill the searchbox with the article title
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await searchbox.fill("NASA Astronaut Nick Hague Retires")
    # Click the search button
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after search
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    # Check if the article is present in the search results
    # Look for an article with the exact title
    try:
        article = page.get_by_role("article", name="NASA Astronaut Nick Hague Retires", exact=True)
        await article.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
        # If found, click the link to the article
        article_link = article.get_by_role("link", name="NASA Astronaut Nick Hague Retires", exact=True)
        await article_link.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for the article page to load
        # Return the URL of the article page
        current_url = page.url
        return current_url
    except Exception as e:
        # Article not found in search results
        return "Article titled 'NASA Astronaut Nick Hague Retires' not found on the website."
